## ⚡ Method 1: Instant Drag & Drop (5 Seconds)

1. Open **Figma** (desktop app or browser at [figma.com](https://figma.com)).
2. Open any Figma design file or draft.
3. Open Windows Explorer at:
   ```
   c:\Users\zaids\Downloads\ui-portfolio\figma-export\
   ```
4. Drag [`zaid-portfolio-light.svg`](file:///c:/Users/zaids/Downloads/ui-portfolio/figma-export/zaid-portfolio-light.svg) or [`zaid-portfolio-dark.svg`](file:///c:/Users/zaids/Downloads/ui-portfolio/figma-export/zaid-portfolio-dark.svg) directly onto your Figma canvas.
5. **Everything is immediately editable**:
   * Double-click any text layer to change words or formatting.
   * Every card (RetroLab, FinTrac AI, SalesSphere, Peach & Paper) is its own vector group with rounded corners.
   * All color fills (`#FAF6EE`, `#1C1C1B`, `#B8925A`) are native vector fills.

## 🚀 Method 2: Native Figma Auto-Layout Plugin (Dynamic Flexbox)

If you want **real Figma Auto-Layout frames** (where containers stretch, padding is responsive, and layers behave like code flexbox):

1. In Figma, click the **Figma Menu** (top-left) → **Plugins** → **Development** → **Import plugin from manifest...**.
2. Select:
   ```
   c:\Users\zaids\Downloads\ui-portfolio\figma-export\figma-plugin\manifest.json
   ```
3. Right-click the Figma canvas → **Plugins** → **Development** → **Frontend to Figma UI Builder**.
4. Click any button in the modal:
   * **Ivory Light Edition (Desktop 1440px)**
   * **Obsidian Dark Edition (Desktop 1440px)**
   * **Mobile Responsive Screen (390px iPhone)**
   * **In-Depth Case Study Screen (1440px)**
   * **Sync Portfolio Color & Text Styles**
5. Figma will immediately generate the entire responsive frame structure on your canvas!
